arabic text: GODDI SE MERE LAAL KO LE-KAR NA JAAI-YE\nBAANU PUKAARI DAAGH YE DE-KAR NA JAAI-YE
english translation text: DO NOT TAKE MY CHILD AWAY FROM MY LAP\nBAANU CRIED DO NOT LEAVE ME DESPODENT

arabic text: QASIM GAE ABBAAS-E DILAAWAR CHALE GAYE\nAVNO MUHAMMAD AUR ALI AKBAR CHALE GAYE\nWAAPIS NA AAYAA LOVT KE MAIDAAN JO GAYAA
english translation text: QASIM AND ABBAS ARE GONE\nAUN, MUHAMMAD AND ALI AKBAR ARE ALSO GONE\nNO ONE HAS RETURNED FROM THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: WAAPIS NA AAYAA LOVT KE MAIDAAN JO GAYAA\nHARGIZ TARAS NA KHAAENGE ASGHER PE ASHQIYAA
english translation text: NO ONE HAS RETURNED FROM THE BATTLEFIELD\nCERTAINLY THE ENEMY WILL HAVE NO PITY ON ASGHER

arabic text: YE AAKHERI SAHAARAA HAI US-KO TO CHHODI-YE\nYE AAKHERI SAHAARAA HAI US-KO TO CHHODI-YE (CHORUS)
english translation text: HE IS MY LAST PILLAR(OF SUPPORT), LEAVE HIM WITH ME\nHE IS MY LAST PILLAR(OF SUPPORT), LEAVE HIM WITH ME

arabic text: YAA SHAAH MUJ GHARIB KO TANHAA NA CHHODI-YE
english translation text: O MASTER I AM DESOLATE DO NOT LEAVE ME ALONE

arabic text: FARMAAYAA TAB HUSAYN NE HAM JAAENGE ZARUR\nSAMJAANAA UNHE FARZ HAI SAMJAAENGE ZARUR
english translation text: THEN HUSSAIN PROCLAIMED THAT I MUST GO\nMAKING THEM UNDERSTAND IS MY DUTY AND I WILL CONVEY OUR MESSAGE

arabic text: AAE HUSAYN FAVJE SITAM GAR KE SAAM NE\nKI GUFTA-GU YAZID KE LASHKAR KE SAAMNE
english translation text: HUSSAIN APPROACHED THE CRUEL ARMY\nHE PREACHED TO THE SOLDIERS (OF THE ENEMY)

arabic text: MAGHRUR HUWE TUM KO KHUDAA YAAD NAHIN HAI\nMAGHRUR HUWE TUM KO KHUDAA YAAD NAHIN HAI
english translation text: ARE YOU SO PROUD THAT YOU HAVE FORGOTTEN ALLAH(SWT)?\nARE YOU SO PROUD THAT YOU HAVE FORGOTTEN ALLAH(SWT)?

arabic text: KYAA GAR ME TUM-HAA-RE KOI AWLAAD NAHIN HAI
english translation text: ARE THERE NO CHILDREN IN YOUR HOMES?

arabic text: DO DIN SE MUJH-PE BAND HAI DARIYAA KE RAAS-TE\nBACHCHAA MERAA TARASTAA HAI PAANI KE WAAS-TE (CHORUS)
english translation text: FOR TWO DAYS YOU HAVE BLOCKED MY PATH TO WATER\nMY CHILD IS TREMBLING FROM THIRST

arabic text: GAR DUISHMANI HAI MUJH-SE TO MUJH-KO NA AAB DO\nBACHCHE NE KYAA QASUR KIYAA HAI JAWAAB DE
english translation text: IF YOUR ENMITY IS AGAINST ME THEN DO NOT GIVE ME WATER\nHAS THIS CHILD COMMITTED ANY WRONG, ANSWER ME?

arabic text: SAYYAD HAI BE GUNAAH HAI MUSAAFIR HAI ZAALIMO\nSAYYAD HAI BE GUNAAH HAI MUSAAFIR HAI ZAALIMO
english translation text: O OPPRESSORS, HE IS A SAYYED, INNOCENT AND A STRANGER (IN THIS LAND)\nO OPPRESSORS, HE IS A SAYYED, INNOCENT AND A STRANGER (IN THIS LAND)

arabic text: YE QAB-RE MUSTAFAA KAA MUJAAVIR HAI ZAALIMO
english translation text: O OPPRESSORS, HE IS THE NEIGHBOUR OF THE SHRINE OF MUSTAFA

arabic text: HAT JAAUNGAA MAI PAAS SE BACHCHE KE AAWO TUM\nAAKER KHUD APNE HAATH SE PAANI PILAAO TUM
english translation text: I WILL MOVE AWAY FROM THE CHILD YOU COME TO HIM\nCOME AND QUENCH HIS THIRST WITH YOUR OWN HANDS

arabic text: YE KEH-KE APNE DILKO SAMBHAALAA HUSAYN NE\nASGHER KO FARSHE KHAAK PE DHAALAA HUSAYN NE
english translation text: SAYING THIS HUSSAIN STEADIED HIMSELF\nHUSSAIN LAY ASGHAR ON THE GROUND

arabic text: TAKRIR NE HUSAYN KI ITNAA KIYAA ASAR\nTAKRIR NE HUSAYN KI ITNAA KIYAA ASAR
english translation text: HUSSAIN'S SPEECH AWOKE THE HEARTS OF THE ARMY (OF YAZID)\nHUSSAIN'S SPEECH AWOKE THE HEARTS OF THE ARMY (OF YAZID)

arabic text: AWLAAD WAALE RO DIYE MUNH PHER PHER KAR
english translation text: FATHERS STARTED WEEPING, TURNING AWAY

arabic text: YE GUFTAGU HUSAYN KI VOH KAAM KAR GAI\nHALCHAL-SI EK FAVJE YAZIDI MEN CHAL GAI (CHORUS)
english translation text: THE SPEECH OF HUSSAIN HAD SUCH AN EFFECT\nTHAT THERE ROSE A GREAT COMMOTION IN THE YAZIDI ARMY

arabic text: DEKHAA JO IB-NE SAAD NE LASHKAR KAA MAAJRAA\nCHIL-LAA KE APNEE FAVJ SE GHUS-SE MEN YUN KAHAA (CHORUS)
english translation text: WHEN IBNE SAAD SAW THE REACTION OF HIS SOLDIERS\nTO HIS SOLDIERS HE SCREAMED:

arabic text: TUM AAJ TARAS AALE PAYAMBAR PE KHAAOGE\nTUM AAJ TARAS AALE PAYAMBAR PE KHAAOGE (CHORUS)
english translation text: TODAY YOU ARE TAKING PITY ON THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD (SAW)\nTODAY YOU ARE TAKING PITY ON THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD (SAW)?

arabic text: DARBAAR ME YAZID KE KUCHH BHI NA PAAOGE
english translation text: YOU WILL NOT BE GRANTED ANY REWARD FROM YAZID

arabic text: EK BE WAFAA SE US-NE ISHAARE ME KUCHH KAHAA\nPAA KAR ISHAARAA FOVJ SE EK BE-HAYAA BAD-HAA
english translation text: HE MOTIONED TO A HEARTLESS SOLDIER\nON SEEING THIS A SHAMELESS SOLDIER AROSE

arabic text: BAANI-E ZULM JORO SITAM HURMALAA BAD-HAA\nBACHCHE KO TEER-E GHAM KAA NISHAANAA BANAA LIYAA
english translation text: THE CRUEL HURMALA STEPPED FORWARD\nHE MADE THE CHILD A TARGET OF THE ARROW

arabic text: CHIKHI FALAK KE TEER CHALAANAA SAMBHAAL KAR\nCHIKHI FALAK KE TEER CHALAANAA SAMBHAAL KAR
english translation text: THE HEAVENS PLEADED: 'BE VERY CAREFUL WITH THE ARROW'\nTHE HEAVENS PLEADED: 'BE VERY CAREFUL WITH THE ARROW'

arabic text: MAA-A-SUM KAA GALAA HAI ZARAA DEKH BHAAL KAR
english translation text: THE NECK BELONGS TO A MA'SUM BE VERY CAUTIOUS

arabic text: KHAIME MEN MAAM-TAA-KAA KALEJAA DA-HAL GAYAA\nTAD-PI IDHAR KAMAAN UDHAR TEER CHAL GAYAA
english translation text: THE BOW TREMBLED AND THE ARROW SHOT OFF\nIN THE TENT, A MOTHERS HEART SANK

arabic text: AFSOS RAHAA DIL PE NA QAABU HUSAYN KAA\nASGHER KAA GALAA CHHID GAYAA BAAZU HUSAYN KAA
english translation text: HOW SAD, HUSSAIN'S HEART BURST OPEN\nASGHER'S NECK AND HUSSAIN'S ARM WERE PIERCED

arabic text: KHENCHAA JO IDHAR TEER UDHAR NABZ CHHUT GAYI\nKHENCHAA JO IDHAR TEER UDHAR NABZ CHHUT GAYI
english translation text: WHEN (HURMALA) PULLED THE ARROW (HUSSAIN'S) PULSE WEAKENED\nWHEN (HURMALA) PULLED THE ARROW (HUSSAIN'S) PULSE WEAKENED

arabic text: SHABBIR KI YE AAKHERI UMMID LUT GAI
english translation text: SHABBIR'S LAST HOPE WAS PLUNDERED
